title: Everest Base Camp Trek
description: The world's most iconic trek. Stand at 5,364m beneath the Khumbu Icefall with Everest filling your entire field of view. A Sherpa-guided 14-day journey through monasteries, rhododendron forests, and high-altitude villages.

days.title: Arrive & briefing
bullets: Fly into TIA, transfer to Thamel hotel
Equipment check and guide briefing
Boudhanath stupa visit for good luck
days.insider_tip: Buy your down jacket on Tridevi Marg — 40% cheaper than renting in Namche.

days.title: Fly to Lukla, first steps
bullets: 25-min mountain flight to Tenzing-Hillary Airport
Trek 3h downhill through rhododendron forest
Cross suspension bridges over the Dudh Kosi river
days.insider_tip: Book the first morning Lukla flight — afternoon fog causes most cancellations.

days.title: Climb to the Sherpa capital
bullets: Steep 3h ascent through pine forest
First views of Everest peek above the ridgeline
Namche Bazaar — the Everest region's only proper town
days.insider_tip: The Namche bakery opens at 7am. Their cinnamon rolls are the best thing you'll eat on the trek.

days.title: Acclimatisation day
bullets: Hike to Everest View Hotel (3,880m) — panoramic views of Everest, Lhotse, Ama Dablam
Visit the Sherpa Museum and Hillary School
Rest afternoon; hydrate aggressively
days.insider_tip: The Saturday market in Namche sells yak cheese, local honey, and fresh-baked bread. Worth waking up for.

days.title: The monastery ridge
bullets: Trek past Khumjung village (Hillary's school)
Dramatic ridge walk with Ama Dablam dead ahead
Tengboche Monastery — largest in the Khumbu
days.insider_tip: Arrive at Tengboche in time for the 3pm puja (prayer ceremony) — open to trekkers.

days.title: Into the high valley
bullets: Descend to Imja Khola river, then steep climb to Dingboche
Panorama of Lhotse South Face and Island Peak
Extra fluids — altitude effects peak here for many
days.insider_tip: Dingboche has the best potato soup on the route. Order it for dinner the night before your acclimatisation hike.

days.title: Acclimatisation — Nagarjun Hill
bullets: Morning hike to Nagarjun Hill (5,100m) — highest point so far
360° views of Makalu, Lhotse, Baruntse, Ama Dablam
Afternoon rest in lodge
days.insider_tip: Altitude headaches hit hardest on day 7-8. Keep diamox ready and don't skip the acclimatisation hike — it works.

days.title: Memorial chortens
bullets: Trek through the Khumbu glacier moraine
Pass Thukla Pass and the climber memorial chortens
Lobuche — last village before Gorak Shep
days.insider_tip: The Lobuche memorial chortens honour climbers who died on Everest. Take time here — it's humbling.

days.title: Base Camp day
bullets: Early start, 4h to Gorak Shep (drop bags)
2h to Everest Base Camp across the Khumbu Glacier
Return to Gorak Shep for the night
days.insider_tip: EBC is most photogenic in late afternoon when the glacier ice turns blue. The actual summit is hidden — Kala Patthar has the better view.

days.title: Kala Patthar sunrise, then down
bullets: Pre-dawn climb to Kala Patthar (5,545m) — best Everest view on the planet
Long descent to Pheriche — knees will feel it
Hot shower and real food in Pheriche
days.insider_tip: Kala Patthar summit at 5:30am. Bring every layer you own — windchill at -20°C is common.

days.title: The knees day
bullets: Long descent past Tengboche and Phunki Tenga
Back to Namche — feels almost luxurious now
Celebration dinner
days.insider_tip: Your knees will be screaming. Trekking poles are not optional on descent — rent them in Namche if you don't have them.

days.title: Final trail day
bullets: One last big descent to Lukla
Farewell raksi with your guide and porter
Lukla guesthouses fill up — book before arriving
days.insider_tip: Tip your porter well — NRs 1,500–2,000/day is the fair standard. They carried everything.

days.title: Fly out, celebrate
bullets: Morning flight back to Kathmandu (weather permitting — book flexible)
Hot shower, real bed, and a meal that isn't dal bhat
Thamel evening
days.insider_tip: Always book a buffer day in Lukla — weather delays are extremely common. Budget one extra night.

days.title: Depart or extend
bullets: City tour or rest day
Shopping for pashminas and thankas in Thamel
Depart or extend with Chitwan / Pokhara
days.insider_tip: Himalayan Java on Thamel Marg has the best espresso in Kathmandu. You've earned it.

title: Annapurna Circuit
description: The classic full circuit — 16 days crossing the Thorong La pass (5,416m) through subtropical forests, Hindu temples, Tibetan villages, and high desert. One of the greatest treks on earth.

days.title: Drive to trailhead
bullets: 6h drive to Besisahar (760m)
Trek introduction briefing
Night in teahouse
days.insider_tip: Take the early bus — afternoon roads into the hills get busy with tourist jeeps.

days.title: Enter the gorge
bullets: Trek through rice paddies and subtropical forest
First suspension bridges over the Marsyangdi river
Night in Bahundanda (1,310m)
days.insider_tip: The Marsyangdi is one of the world's fastest-dropping rivers. The gorge walls close in dramatically from day 2 onward.

days.title: Waterfalls day
bullets: Multiple waterfalls along the trail
Steep climb out of the gorge then down again
Cross the Marsyangdi several times
days.insider_tip: Fill water bottles at the last village before the big climb — next reliable water is 2h away.

days.title: Enter the Himalaya
bullets: Climb steadily into Manang district
First alpine views as the vegetation changes
Dharapani — entry to the restricted Manang zone
days.insider_tip: Check your TIMS and ACAP permits at the checkpoint. Missing either means turning back.

days.title: High valley floor
bullets: Chame — district headquarters, last ATM before Manang
Pine forests and the dramatic Paungda Danda rock face
Hot springs in Chame
days.insider_tip: The Chame hot springs are hidden behind the main teahouses — ask your guide. Worth it after a long day.

days.title: Annapurna II reveals itself
bullets: Dramatic curved mountain face on the approach to Pisang
Lower Pisang has guesthouses; upper Pisang has the monastery
First views of the full Annapurna range
days.insider_tip: Stay in Upper Pisang for sunrise views over the valley — the lower village is fine but the views are ordinary.

days.title: Acclimatisation walk to Manang
bullets: Trek via Bhraka and Ngawal for better views than the valley road
Tibetan culture becomes dominant — prayer flags everywhere
Manang — largest village before the pass
days.insider_tip: The Manang bakery is genuinely excellent. Stock up on energy bars and walnut cake for the pass day.

days.title: Acclimatisation day
bullets: Hike to Gangapurna Lake (3,540m) — stunning glacier lake
Optional: Ice Lake (4,600m) for serious acclimatisation
Altitude briefing at the Himalayan Rescue Association clinic (mandatory)
days.insider_tip: The HRA clinic in Manang gives a free daily talk on altitude sickness at 3pm. Don't skip it — it saves lives.

days.title: High pastures
bullets: Gradual climb to 4,018m through yak grazing land
Apple orchards and mani walls
Short day — rest is key before the pass
days.insider_tip: Eat a big dinner tonight. You'll need every calorie for tomorrow's 5am start.

days.title: The big pass
bullets: 3am start to beat afternoon winds on Thorong La (5,416m)
4-5h climb to the pass, then 1,600m descent to Muktinath
Muktinath — sacred Hindu and Buddhist temple at 3,800m
days.insider_tip: The descent is brutal on knees but stunning. Take poles. The tea house at the top of the pass has the best hot lemon of your life.

days.title: Into the Mustang landscape
bullets: Trek down the Jhong Khola valley to Kagbeni
Mars-like landscape — red and ochre cliffs, zero vegetation
Kagbeni — gateway to Upper Mustang
days.insider_tip: Kagbeni has the best dal bhat on the circuit. The Red House Lodge is legendary among trekkers.

days.title: Apple brandy country
bullets: Pass through Jomsom — regional hub and airstrip
Marpha — the apple capital of Nepal
Sample local apple brandy (raksi) and apple pie
days.insider_tip: Marpha apple products are excellent — buy jams and dried apple chips to take home.

days.title: Long descent to hot springs
bullets: Long downhill day through subtropical forest
Tatopani — famous hot springs at the bottom of the valley
Soak for as long as you like
days.insider_tip: Tatopani's riverside hot spring pools fill up by 5pm. Get there by 4pm.

days.title: The punishing climb
bullets: 2,000m climb from hot springs to Ghorepani
One of the hardest ascent days on the circuit
Rhododendron forest — spectacular in bloom (March-April)
days.insider_tip: This climb is harder than the pass for most people. Start at 7am and take your time.

days.title: Poon Hill sunrise, then out
bullets: Pre-dawn hike to Poon Hill (3,210m) — Annapurna panorama at sunrise
Long descent to Nayapul via Ulleri
Jeep or bus to Pokhara
days.insider_tip: Poon Hill at sunrise with Dhaulagiri and the full Annapurna range in alpenglow is one of the great mountain views on earth.

days.title: Rest in Pokhara
bullets: Lakeside Pokhara — rest and celebrate
Phewa Lake boat ride
Farewell dinner
days.insider_tip: The Pokhara waterfront has great sunset views. Book a table at an outdoor lakeside restaurant for your last evening.

title: Annapurna Base Camp Trek
description: Enter the Annapurna Sanctuary — a glacial amphitheatre ringed by 8,000m peaks. 9 days through terraced villages, rhododendron forests, and a dramatic final push to the base of Annapurna I.

days.title: Trail start
bullets: Drive 1.5h from Pokhara to Nayapul
Trek through Modi Khola valley
Night in Tikhedunga
days.insider_tip: The trail to ABC is heavily walked — the teahouses are good but book ahead in peak season (Oct-Nov).

days.title: Climb through rhododendrons
bullets: 3,500-step stone staircase to Ulleri
Rhododendron forest in full bloom (March-April)
Ghorepani — classic mountain village
days.insider_tip: The rhododendron forest between Ulleri and Ghorepani is the most beautiful forest section of any Nepal trek in bloom season.

days.title: Poon Hill optional sunrise, ridge walk
bullets: Optional pre-dawn Poon Hill hike (3,210m) for panoramic views
Ridge walk through giant rhododendron trees to Tadapani
Good Annapurna South and Hiunchuli views
days.insider_tip: If you're doing Poon Hill, wake at 4:30am. The walk to the viewpoint takes 45 minutes.

days.title: Gateway to the Sanctuary
bullets: Cross the Modi Khola, climb to Chhomrong
Last major village before the Sanctuary
Chhomrong — check permits here
days.insider_tip: Chhomrong has the best panorama of Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre (Fishtail) of the entire trek.

days.title: Into the gorge
bullets: Descend to the Chhomrong Khola then climb steeply
Forest thickens — leeches in monsoon season
Cross bamboo bridges over multiple streams
days.insider_tip: Check leech conditions before you go. April-September means long trousers and salt in your pockets.

days.title: The sacred mountain looms
bullets: Trek through Himalaya Hotel and Hinku Cave
Machhapuchhre BC (3,700m) — first views of the Fishtail peak
Annapurna Base Camp visible ahead
days.insider_tip: Machhapuchhre (Fishtail) is the only peak in Nepal that has never been summited — it's considered the home of Shiva.

days.title: The Sanctuary
bullets: 2h walk into the glacial sanctuary bowl
Surrounded on all sides by 7,000-8,000m peaks
Annapurna I South Face looms directly overhead
days.insider_tip: Arrive at ABC before 10am — clouds build fast and obscure the mountains by midday. Sunrise from ABC is extraordinary.

days.title: Long descent
bullets: Retrace down through the Sanctuary and gorge
Descent is much faster — knees will feel it
Rest in Bamboo
days.insider_tip: On the way down you notice things you missed going up — the bird diversity in the lower forest is exceptional.

days.title: Out and celebrate
bullets: Trek out to Nayapul via Jhinu hot springs (optional 2h detour)
Drive back to Pokhara
Lakeside dinner to celebrate
days.insider_tip: The Jhinu hot springs are a 30-minute detour from the main trail on day 9. Worth every minute after 8 days of trekking.

title: Poon Hill Trek
description: Nepal's most popular short trek. Four days through Gurung villages and rhododendron forests to Poon Hill (3,210m) — a panoramic sunrise viewpoint of the entire Dhaulagiri and Annapurna ranges. Perfect first trek.

days.title: Drive and first steps
bullets: 1.5h drive from Pokhara to Nayapul
Trek 3h to Tikhedunga through villages
First mountain views on clear days
days.insider_tip: Leave Pokhara by 8am to arrive in Tikhedunga with time for a proper lunch.

days.title: The famous stone staircase
bullets: 3,500 stone steps to Ulleri — the hardest section
Rhododendron forest above Ulleri (stunning March-April)
Ghorepani village — comfortable lodges, hot showers
days.insider_tip: Count the steps if you need something to focus on. Most people make it in 4h at a moderate pace.

days.title: The sunrise you came for
bullets: 4:30am start, 45min climb to Poon Hill (3,210m)
Dhaulagiri (8,167m), Annapurna I (8,091m), Machhapuchhre in alpenglow
Ridge walk through old-growth rhododendron trees to Tadapani
days.insider_tip: Poon Hill has 50+ people at sunrise in peak season. Position yourself on the left side of the viewing platform for the best Dhaulagiri angle.

days.title: Gurung village and out
bullets: Descent to Ghandruk — one of Nepal's most beautiful Gurung villages
Ghandruk Museum — Gurung culture and history
Jeep out from Kimchi or trek to Nayapul
days.insider_tip: Ghandruk has a small museum run by local women's cooperatives. Buy a pashmina here — the money goes directly to the village.

title: Langtang Valley Trek
description: Closest major trek to Kathmandu. 8 days through the Langtang National Park to the high-altitude cheese factories and Kyanjin Gompa beneath the 7,227m Langtang Lirung. Uncrowded compared to Annapurna and Everest.

days.title: Drive to trailhead
bullets: 7h drive from Kathmandu through scenic hills
Syabrubesi — entry point to Langtang
Evening walk around village
days.insider_tip: The road to Syabrubesi is rough after Dhunche. Take the morning bus and bring motion sickness tablets.

days.title: Forest ascent
bullets: Trek through subtropical and temperate forest
Langtang river accompanies you all day
Lama Hotel — basic but comfortable
days.insider_tip: The Langtang river is crystal clear — you can drink it directly above Syabrubesi. Below it's compromised.

days.title: Enter the high valley
bullets: Forest gives way to open valley with Himalayan views
Pass the memorial to the 2015 earthquake victims
Langtang village — rebuilt after the avalanche
days.insider_tip: The 2015 earthquake and avalanche destroyed the original Langtang village. The rebuilt village is a testament to community resilience.

days.title: The cheese factory
bullets: Short trek to Kyanjin Gompa (3,870m)
Visit the government-run yak cheese factory
Kyanjin Ri hike for afternoon views
days.insider_tip: The Langtang cheese is famous — buy a whole wheel. They vacuum-pack it for travel.

days.title: High point — Tsergo Ri
bullets: Climb to Tsergo Ri (4,984m) for panoramic views of Langtang Lirung and the glacier
Return to Kyanjin for the night
Full day above 4,000m
days.insider_tip: Tsergo Ri is not technically difficult but the altitude makes it feel like Everest. Start at 6am.

days.title: Begin descent
bullets: Same trail back but different light
Faster descent — many do in 5h
Lama Hotel feels luxurious compared to Kyanjin
days.insider_tip: On the descent you'll see the valley from different angles. The forest section is quieter and you'll spot more wildlife.

days.title: Final trail day
bullets: Last forest section back to Syabrubesi
Hot springs optional detour (Tatopani, 1h off route)
Evening in Syabrubesi
days.insider_tip: The Syabrubesi hot spring is 20min from the village — a perfect end-of-trek soak.

days.title: Drive back
bullets: 7h drive back to Kathmandu
Arrive in time for dinner in Thamel
Debrief with guide over dal bhat
days.insider_tip: The drive back passes through Dhunche where you can see Ganesh Himal and Langtang Lirung from the road.

title: Kathmandu Valley Heritage Trail
description: Four UNESCO World Heritage Sites in four days. Walk between ancient Newari cities, Hindu temples, Buddhist stupas, and living goddesses. No altitude, no trekking — pure culture.

days.title: Boudhanath and Pashupatinath
bullets: Boudhanath Stupa — one of the world's largest Buddhist stupas
Pashupatinath temple — holiest Hindu site in Nepal (riverside cremation ghats)
Thamel evening walk
days.insider_tip: Pashupatinath is most vivid at dawn (5-7am) when the cremation ceremonies take place. Respectful observation from the far bank is welcome.

days.title: The medieval city
bullets: Bhaktapur Durbar Square — the best-preserved medieval city in Asia
Pottery Square — potters still using 500-year-old wheels
Nyatapola Temple — the tallest pagoda in Nepal
55-Window Palace
days.insider_tip: Bhaktapur charges a separate entry fee. Stay overnight to see it in the morning before the day-trippers arrive — it's magical.

days.title: The city of fine arts
bullets: Patan Durbar Square — finest example of Newari architecture
Patan Museum — best museum in Nepal
Krishna Mandir and the golden window
Traditional craftsmen's quarter
days.insider_tip: The Patan Museum has the best collection of Hindu and Buddhist bronzes outside of the British Museum. Give it 2 hours.

days.title: Monkey temple and the oldest shrine
bullets: Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple) — hilltop stupa with panoramic valley views
Changu Narayan — oldest temple in the valley (4th century)
Return to Kathmandu for farewell dinner
days.insider_tip: Swayambhunath at sunrise (6am) has almost no tourists and extraordinary light. The monkeys are less active and more photogenic.

title: Classic Nepal — Kathmandu, Chitwan & Pokhara
description: The iconic 10-day triangle covering Nepal's three must-sees: the ancient temples of Kathmandu, jungle safari in Chitwan, and the lakeside city of Pokhara with Annapurna views. Nepal's most booked itinerary.

days.title: Arrive, Thamel, Boudhanath
bullets: Arrive TIA, transfer to hotel
Boudhanath stupa evening walk
Thamel dinner and rest
days.insider_tip: Boudhanath at dusk when monks circle the stupa with butter lamps is one of the most peaceful scenes in Nepal.

days.title: Durbar Squares
bullets: Pashupatinath temple morning visit
Kathmandu Durbar Square and Kumari courtyard (living goddess)
Swayambhunath at sunset
days.insider_tip: The Kumari (living goddess) appears at her window daily at certain times. Ask your guide for today's schedule.

days.title: Medieval city then jungle drive
bullets: Morning in Bhaktapur — medieval Newari architecture
Afternoon drive to Chitwan (4-5h) or short domestic flight
Jungle resort arrival and briefing
days.insider_tip: The drive to Chitwan via Prithvi Highway passes through stunning Trisuli River gorge. Sit on the left side of the bus.

days.title: Jeep safari and jungle walk
bullets: 6am jeep safari — best tiger and one-horned rhino sightings at dawn
Guided jungle walk — spot sloth bears, deer, crocodiles
Elephant interaction (ethical — no rides, observe in natural habitat)
days.insider_tip: Dawn jeep safari is always better than evening. Predators hunt at first light. Book with a guide who knows the park's northern grasslands.

days.title: Canoe and village
bullets: Dugout canoe down the Rapti river — gharial crocodiles sunbathing on banks
Tharu cultural village tour and stick dance performance
Bird watching — 543 species recorded in the park
days.insider_tip: The Rapti canoe trip is the most underrated activity in Chitwan. 10 minutes in, you'll see gharials closer than you imagined possible.

days.title: Travel to the lakeside city
bullets: Morning drive or flight to Pokhara
Check in to lakeside hotel
Sunset walk along Phewa Lake
days.insider_tip: The drive Chitwan → Pokhara via the Prithvi Highway is genuinely beautiful. If the weather is clear, you'll see the Annapurna range for the last hour.

days.title: Sarangkot sunrise, lake day
bullets: 4:30am drive to Sarangkot (1,592m) — Annapurna and Dhaulagiri sunrise panorama
Phewa Lake boat trip to Tal Barahi island temple
Lakeside afternoon at leisure
days.insider_tip: Sarangkot sunrise is Pokhara's equivalent of Poon Hill — and easier to access. Book a taxi the night before.

days.title: Paragliding, caves, museum
bullets: Paragliding over Pokhara with Annapurna as backdrop (40min flight)
Mahendra Cave and Bat Cave
International Mountain Museum
days.insider_tip: Pokhara paragliding is the most popular in Asia. Book with Blue Sky Paragliding — they're Nepal's most established operator.

days.title: Return and farewell dinner
bullets: 25-min flight back to Kathmandu (stunning mountain views on clear days)
Last shopping in Thamel
Farewell dinner at a rooftop restaurant
days.insider_tip: Book the afternoon flight KTM→Pokhara for mountain views — and sit on the left side going, right side returning.

days.title: Depart
bullets: Last morning at leisure
Transfer to TIA
Depart Nepal
days.insider_tip: Arrive at TIA 3 hours before international flights — security queues can be unpredictable.

title: Chitwan National Park Safari
description: Three focused days in one of Asia's best wildlife parks. One-horned rhinoceros, Bengal tigers, gharial crocodiles, and 543 bird species in the Terai jungle. UNESCO World Heritage Site.

days.title: Arrive, afternoon canoe & village
bullets: Transfer from Kathmandu or Pokhara
Dugout canoe on the Rapti River — gharial and mugger crocodiles
Tharu village walk and cultural show
days.insider_tip: Check in to your jungle lodge by 2pm to catch the afternoon canoe. The activity timing is tightly scheduled.

days.title: Full safari day
bullets: 5:30am jeep safari — peak tiger and rhino activity
Guided jungle walk with armed ranger
Elephant observation at sunrise (not rides — ethical interaction)
days.insider_tip: Tiger sightings average 1 per 4 safari days. Don't be disappointed if you don't see one — a single rhino encounter at dawn is just as profound.

days.title: Morning safari, depart
bullets: One final dawn jeep safari
Brunch at the lodge
Transfer back to Kathmandu or Pokhara
days.insider_tip: The last morning safari often has the best sightings — guides know the animal patterns and route accordingly.

title: Bardia National Park — Remote Safari
description: Nepal's largest national park and its best-kept secret. Far fewer tourists than Chitwan, with some of Asia's highest tiger and elephant densities. A genuine wilderness experience.

days.title: Fly west, enter the jungle
bullets: Morning domestic flight to Nepalgunj (1.5h)
Drive 3h to Bardia — virtually no tourists in sight
Evening briefing and orientation walk
days.insider_tip: Bardia sees 5% of the visitors Chitwan does. The experience is raw and real.

days.title: Karnali river safari
bullets: Dawn boat safari on the Karnali river
Gangetic dolphins, gharials, and marsh mugger crocodiles
Afternoon jungle walk in the core zone
days.insider_tip: The Gangetic river dolphin is critically endangered. Bardia's Karnali river has one of the healthiest populations left on earth.

days.title: Deep jungle — tiger territory
bullets: Full-day tracked walking safari in core tiger zone
Armed ranger with decades of tracking experience
Nilgai antelope, spotted deer, wild boar sightings guaranteed
days.insider_tip: Walking safaris in Bardia bring you far closer to wildlife than vehicles. The ranger reads pugmarks and broken grass — stay close and quiet.

days.title: Wild elephant tracking
bullets: Track wild Asian elephant herds in the flood plain
Tharu village cultural immersion — traditional meal
Night safari by boat
days.insider_tip: Bardia has over 100 wild elephants. Unlike Chitwan, these are genuinely wild — encounters are on their terms.

days.title: Final dawn, fly home
bullets: Last dawn safari
Drive to Nepalgunj
Afternoon flight back to Kathmandu
days.insider_tip: The flight Nepalgunj-KTM on clear days reveals the entire Dhaulagiri-Annapurna-Ganesh Himal-Langtang range. Window seat on the right.

title: Muktinath Pilgrimage
description: One of the holiest sites in Asia — sacred to both Hindus and Buddhists. Drive through the world's deepest gorge, fly to Jomsom, and trek to the Muktinath temple at 3,800m in the high Mustang desert.

days.title: Fly to the lake city
bullets: 25-min flight from KTM to Pokhara
Lakeside afternoon
Prepare for early morning Jomsom flight
days.insider_tip: The Jomsom flight is one of the most dramatic in the world. Confirm your booking the evening before.

days.title: Fly into the Mustang
bullets: 6am Jomsom flight through the Kali Gandaki gorge — world's deepest
Jomsom — border town at the edge of restricted Mustang
Trek 2h to Kagbeni — gateway to Upper Mustang
days.insider_tip: The Jomsom flight window is 6-8am only. After 9am, channel winds make the approach impossible.

days.title: The sacred ascent
bullets: Trek 3h uphill through ochre desert and mani walls
Muktinath temple complex at 3,800m
108 water spouts ritual bathing and flame temple
days.insider_tip: The 108 water spouts at Muktinath are glacially cold. Devout pilgrims bathe under all 108. Most tourists do 1.

days.title: Deeper pilgrimage
bullets: Jwala Mai — the eternal flame temple fed by natural gas seeps
Visit Guru Rinpoche cave monastery above the main temple
Buddhist and Hindu ritual ceremonies
days.insider_tip: Muktinath is one of the 108 Vishnu temples (Divya Desams). The flame that burns on water is considered a miracle in both Hindu and Buddhist traditions.

days.title: Descent through apple country
bullets: Trek down through Jharkot and Khinga villages
Marpha — the apple brandy capital of Nepal
Sample local produce and visit the monastery
days.insider_tip: Marpha's apple orchards produce Nepal's most famous raksi (spirits). The local cooperative sells directly.

days.title: Final night at 2,720m
bullets: Short pleasant trek along the Kali Gandaki
Jomsom evening — explore the military town
Confirm morning flight
days.insider_tip: Jomsom's Nilgiri Hotel has the best views of the surrounding peaks. Book well in advance.

days.title: Fly back, reflect
bullets: Morning Jomsom-Pokhara flight
Connecting KTM flight or overnight in Pokhara
Debrief and depart
days.insider_tip: The Jomsom to Pokhara flight takes 20 minutes but covers terrain that took 5 days to walk. The juxtaposition is extraordinary.

title: Gosaikunda Sacred Lakes Trek
description: A high-altitude pilgrimage trail to the sacred Gosaikunda lakes (4,380m) — the source of the Bagmati river and home to Lord Shiva. Combines the Helambu region's Hyolmo culture with Tamang heritage.

days.title: Edge of the city, into the forest
bullets: Drive to Sundarijal (1,460m) — start of the Shivapuri ridge
Trek through Shivapuri National Park
Night in Chisapani with valley views
days.insider_tip: Sundarijal is at the edge of Kathmandu — it's surreal how quickly the city disappears into the forest.

days.title: Ridge walk
bullets: Long ridge walk through Helambu forests
Hyolmo villages with Tibetan-influenced culture
Panoramic views of Langtang and Ganesh Himal
days.insider_tip: The Helambu region is largely unknown to trekkers. You'll walk most days without seeing another foreigner.

days.title: Forest and altitude
bullets: Climb through rhododendron forest
Tharepati (3,490m) — junction for Gosaikunda and Helambu trails
First views of distant Himalayan peaks
days.insider_tip: At Tharepati, the trail splits. Keep to the Gosaikunda branch — it's less-walked and the views open dramatically.

days.title: High country
bullets: Traverse high ridges above 3,000m
Tin-roofed teahouses in remote meadows
Views of the Jugal and Rolwaling ranges
days.insider_tip: Very few trekkers on this section. You may have the trail to yourself. It's the real Nepal.

days.title: The sacred lake
bullets: Climb to Gosaikunda (4,380m) — first views of the sacred lakes
Main lake and three smaller satellite lakes
Hindu ritual at lakeside shrine
days.insider_tip: At the full moon in July-August, over 50,000 Hindu pilgrims walk here for the Janai Purnima festival. At any other time you may be alone with the lake.

days.title: Steep descent
bullets: Long steep descent to Sing Gompa (cheese factory)
Continue down to Dhunche — regional hub
Hot meal and rest
days.insider_tip: Sing Gompa's yak cheese factory makes excellent cheese. It's the same production as the Langtang factory — same government operation.

days.title: Drive home
bullets: 4h drive back to Kathmandu on the Trishuli highway
Pass through Trishuli Bazar — river rafting hub
Return to Kathmandu by afternoon
days.insider_tip: The drive back follows the Trishuli river. In spring you'll see dozens of rafting groups on the rapids below.

title: Pokhara Wellness & Yoga Retreat
description: Five restorative days in the lakeside city of Pokhara — Nepal's wellness capital. Yoga at sunrise with Annapurna views, Ayurvedic treatments, meditation sessions, and gentle nature walks.

days.title: Arrive and settle
bullets: Fly from Kathmandu (25min) or drive (6-7h)
Check in to retreat centre or lakeside hotel
Orientation walk along Phewa Lake at sunset
days.insider_tip: The best wellness retreats in Pokhara are on the quieter southern end of the lake, away from the tourist strip.

days.title: Sunrise yoga, Annapurna morning
bullets: 6am sunrise yoga session — Dhaulagiri and Annapurna in full view
Breakfast on the lakeside
Sarangkot morning hike for mountain panorama
days.insider_tip: Morning yoga on a rooftop with the Annapurna range is the defining Pokhara experience. Book a retreat that specifically offers this.

days.title: Ayurveda and meditation
bullets: Ayurvedic consultation and 3h treatment programme
Afternoon meditation session
Phewa Lake boat ride — island temple
days.insider_tip: Pokhara has some of Nepal's best Ayurvedic practitioners. A proper 3h treatment with panchakarma is significantly cheaper here than India.

days.title: Nature walk — World Peace Stupa
bullets: Morning walk to the World Peace Stupa (1,100m) above the lake
Japanese-funded stupa with stunning views of Pokhara and Annapurna
Afternoon free — kayaking, swimming, reading
days.insider_tip: The walk to the Peace Stupa takes 90 minutes from the lakeside. Go early — the light on Machhapuchhre (Fishtail) is best before 10am.

days.title: Final morning practice, depart
bullets: Last morning yoga and meditation
Lakeside walk and final Himalayan views
Flight or drive back to Kathmandu
days.insider_tip: Leave Pokhara with the mental clarity you came for. Many visitors return every year.

title: Manaslu Circuit
description: The best off-the-beaten-path alternative to the Annapurna Circuit. 16 days crossing the Larkya La pass (5,160m) around the world's 8th highest mountain through Tibetan-influenced Nubri villages. Requires restricted area permit.

days.title: Drive to trailhead
bullets: 7h drive to Arughat Bazar (460m)
Gorkha district — birthplace of Nepal's unification
Permit check at the entry checkpoint
days.insider_tip: Manaslu requires a restricted area permit ($100/week) AND a registered guide — non-negotiable. Solo trekking is not permitted.

days.title: Into the gorge
bullets: Trek through subtropical forest
Budhi Gandaki river gorge narrowing
First villages of the Manaslu conservation area
days.insider_tip: The lower gorge feels oppressively narrow. By day 4 it opens to reveal the reason you came: the Manaslu massif.

days.title: Waterfalls and suspension bridges
bullets: Cross and re-cross the Budhi Gandaki river
Multiple waterfalls, leeches in wet season
Machha Khola — fish market village
days.insider_tip: The Manaslu trail has the highest density of suspension bridges of any Nepal trek — over 40 crossings.

days.title: Culture shifts
bullets: Trek to Tatopani (hot springs)
Landscape shifts from tropical to temperate
First Tibetan prayer flags and mani walls appear
days.insider_tip: The Tatopani hot springs on this trail are natural and completely undeveloped — a pool by the river, no facilities.

days.title: Into Nubri
bullets: Cross into the Nubri region — Tibetan Buddhist culture
Gho village — traditional stone houses
Views of Sringi Himal
days.insider_tip: From Deng onward you're in culturally Tibetan territory. The dialect, dress, and architecture shift noticeably.

days.title: Climb steepens
bullets: Steep trail through old-growth forest
Namrung village — large monastery
First views of Manaslu's northern face
days.insider_tip: The monastery in Namrung has murals dating to the 12th century. Your guide can arrange an entry — it's extraordinary.

days.title: Manaslu reveals itself
bullets: Lho village — first dramatic Manaslu (8,163m) view
Pungen Glacier viewpoint above the village
Tibetan-style houses with flat roofs
days.insider_tip: The view of Manaslu from Lho is arguably the finest mountain face view of any Nepal trek — bigger than Everest from Namche.

days.title: High plateau culture
bullets: Trek through Shyala and into the Sama plateau
Sama Gaon (3,530m) — largest village on the route
Pungyen Gompa hike for glacier views
days.insider_tip: Sama Gaon has an excellent teahouse with a wood stove and real beds. It's as close to comfort as you'll get on this circuit.

days.title: Acclimatisation
bullets: Hike to Manaslu Base Camp (4,480m) for close glacier views
Birendra Tal — turquoise lake at the foot of Manaslu
Afternoon rest and hydration
days.insider_tip: Manaslu Base Camp in spring has expedition teams preparing for the summit. The scale of the mountain from 4,480m is incomprehensible.

days.title: High desert
bullets: Short but high-altitude trek to Samdo (3,860m)
Tibetan refugee community and monastery
Last supply point before the pass
days.insider_tip: Stock up on snacks in Samdo — the teahouses beyond are basic. Energy bars and instant coffee are worth carrying.

days.title: Acclimatise at Dharamsala
bullets: Hike to Larkya La high camp (Dharamsala, 4,460m)
Return to Samdo for the night
Early to bed — 3am start tomorrow
days.insider_tip: The Dharamsala shelter is very basic. Bring your sleeping bag and extra layers — it's -10°C before the pass.

days.title: The great crossing
bullets: 3am start, 5h to Larkya La (5,160m)
360° views of Manaslu, Cheo Himal, Himlung
Long 1,800m descent to Bimthang (3,720m)
days.insider_tip: The Larkya La is genuinely hard — wind, altitude, and a long technical descent combine. Go slow on the ascent and save energy for the descent.

days.title: Descent through apple orchards
bullets: Long descent to lower elevations
Apple orchards reappear
Annapurna II and IV visible to the south
days.insider_tip: After the cold and altitude, Tilije's apple orchards at 2,300m feel almost tropical.

days.title: Canyon country
bullets: Pass through Dharapani — connects to Annapurna Circuit
Kali Gandaki and Marshyangdi rivers join here
Tal waterfall
days.insider_tip: You're now at the junction with the Annapurna Circuit. Experienced trekkers sometimes combine both circuits — 30+ days.

days.title: Final trail day
bullets: Descend the last section to the trailhead
Beshisahar — end of the circuit
Hot meal and debrief with your guide
days.insider_tip: The last day is long but downhill. You'll arrive in Beshisahar feeling like a different person than the one who started.

days.title: Drive home
bullets: 5h drive back to Kathmandu
Hot shower, real bed, celebration dinner
Depart or extend
days.insider_tip: You've just done one of the world's great treks with a fraction of the crowds of EBC or Annapurna. That's the Manaslu reward.

title: Lumbini & Southern Nepal Heritage
description: The birthplace of Buddha and Nepal's most sacred cultural site. Three days in Lumbini's UNESCO sacred garden, ancient Ashokan pillar, and the international monastery zone with temples from 19 countries.

days.title: Fly to the birthplace of Buddha
bullets: 1h flight to Bhairahawa, then 30min drive to Lumbini
Check in to guesthouse or monastery accommodation
Evening walk in the Sacred Garden
days.insider_tip: Several monasteries in Lumbini offer accommodation to pilgrims for free or donation. The Korean and Myanmar monasteries are particularly welcoming.

days.title: The Sacred Garden
bullets: Maya Devi Temple — exact birthplace of Siddhartha Gautama
Ashokan Pillar (249 BC) — oldest inscription in the Indian subcontinent
Sacred Pond where Maya Devi bathed before giving birth
days.insider_tip: Visit the Maya Devi Temple at 6am before the crowds. The Archaeological site with the marker stone is the most historically significant place in Nepal.

days.title: International monastery zone
bullets: Walk the 3km monastery road — temples from China, Japan, Korea, Myanmar, Germany, France and 14 other countries
World Peace Flame at the centre of the zone
Lumbini Museum for Buddhist art and history
days.insider_tip: The Japanese monastery has a 40m white pagoda that's visible from miles away. The interior has remarkable modern Buddhist art.

days.title: Final morning reflection, depart
bullets: Early morning meditation in the Sacred Garden (very peaceful)
Visit Tilaurakot — the ancient Shakya palace where Buddha spent his youth (25km from Lumbini)
Afternoon flight back to Kathmandu
days.insider_tip: Tilaurakot is completely off the tourist trail — a ruined palace complex where the Buddha lived as Prince Siddhartha. Hire a bike from Lumbini to visit.
